title: Anwendungsarchitekt - Full-Stack Java/Spring, React, K8s (m/w/d)
description: Du wirst Teil eines KI-nativen Start-ups in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, dessen Produkt seinen Product-Market-Fit bereits unter Beweis gestellt hat. Wir entwickeln modernste KI-Lösungen für Governance, Risikomanagement und Compliance (GRC) für Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden sind Auditoren, Risikomanager und Compliance-Teams. Deshalb sind gründliche Evaluierung, Auditierbarkeit und die Vorbereitung auf die Anforderungen der EU-KI-Verordnung für uns keine nachträglichen Ergänzungen, sondern feste Produktanforderungen. Aufgaben Als Anwendungsarchitekt (m/w/d) gehörst du zu unseren ersten Senior-Entwicklern in Vollzeit und arbeitest eng mit unserem Mitgründer und CTO zusammen. Du verantwortest die Backend-Architektur und hilfst dem Team, Qualität und Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit mit dem Wachstum zu steigern. In den ersten 6–12 Monaten wirst du: eine klare Zielarchitektur und eine solide Dokumentationsgrundlage mit arc42 etablieren; das zentrale Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien präzisieren und im Team vermitteln; einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess einführen und standardisieren – von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung; die Entwicklungspraxis durch Coaching, Pair Programming und Feedbackschleifen stärken, insbesondere für Junior-Entwickler; die Zuverlässigkeit und Softwareauslieferung durch bessere CI/CD-Prozesse , Testautomatisierung und eine sauber gepflegte Infrastruktur verbessern. Verantwortlichkeiten Gemeinsam mit dem Team überzeugende Lösungen für neuartige Problemstellungen in einer AI-first-Architektur entwickeln. Einen DevOps-orientierten Ansatz über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg vorantreiben: von der Spezifikation über die Entwicklung bis zur Auslieferung – inspiriert vom DevOps Handbook . Ansätze vorschlagen und umsetzen, die die Softwareauslieferung schneller und zuverlässiger machen, etwa durch einen besseren Arbeitsfluss, kürzere Feedbackschleifen und eine schnellere Wiederherstellung nach Störungen. Systemübergreifendes Monitoring und Observability aufbauen und weiterentwickeln – einschließlich Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alarmierung –, damit wir Probleme frühzeitig erkennen und aus dem Produktivbetrieb lernen. Junior-Entwickler coachen und gemeinsam mit ihnen bewährte Entwicklungs-, Design- und Architekturpraktiken anwenden. Zusammen mit dem Team einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess gestalten, von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung. Die Backend-Architektur mit dem arc42-Framework planen und dokumentieren. Das Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien erweitern und verständlich vermitteln. Die Anwendungsinfrastruktur auf Azure mit Pulumi verwalten und ausbauen. Qualifikation Unverzichtbare Voraussetzungen Erfahrung mit dem arc42-Framework (ISAQB) und C4 . Erfahrung darin, Entwicklungsteams zu führen und zu befähigen . Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Java Spring Boot (MVC, JPA, Security) . Fundierte Kenntnisse in Entwurfsmustern und Domain-Driven Design . Hervorragende Codequalität auf Basis von Clean-Code- und SOLID-Prinzipien . Umfassende Erfahrung mit TDD und BDD . Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Webentwicklung mit React und Angular . Darüber hinaus überzeugst du mit … Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code auf Azure oder AWS mit Pulumi. Einer ausgeprägten DevOps-Mentalität – das DevOps Handbook ist deine Bibel – und Erfahrung beim Aufbau von: zuverlässigen CI/CD-Pipelines und Release-Prozessen; produktionsreifem Monitoring und Observability sowie Verfahren zur Reaktion auf Betriebsstörungen; kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen, etwa durch die Nachbereitung von Störungen, das Lernen aus dem Betrieb und die Priorisierung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit. Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Entwicklungsworkflows. IntelliJ-Kenntnissen auf Power-User-Niveau. Benefits Eigenverantwortliche, praktische Arbeit an einem echten KI-Produkt, das bereits von Unternehmenskunden eingesetzt wird. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam vom ersten Tag an. Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Standort im Münchner Norden, mindestens ein Tag pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten flexibel. Bei besonders guter Passung sind wir auch offen für qualifizierte Kandidaten aus anderen Teilen der EU. Die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort im Büro statt. Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von LLM-Engineering, GRC im Unternehmensumfeld und dem operativen Aufbau eines Start-ups. Die Möglichkeit, unser KI-Team mitzugestalten, während wir wachsen. Auxilius ai entwickelt KI-gestützte GRC-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Wir befinden uns in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, wachsen schnell und können bereits auf echte Kunden bauen. Unser Technologie-Stack umfasst Java und Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes auf Azure sowie LLMs von OpenAI und Anthropic. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Enterprise Risk Management (m/w/d)
description: Dein neues Team: Du willst verstehen, wie ein FinTech seine wichtigsten Risiken steuert und dabei selbst mit anpacken, um Abläufe mit Daten, digitalen Workflows und KI effizienter zu machen? Dann bist Du bei uns richtig. Im Enterprise Risk Management von auxmoney arbeitest Du an Themen wie Internes Kontrollsystem, operationelle Risiken und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Risikomanagementstandards. title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Risk & Pricing (m/f/d)
description: Your new team: As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. What you can expect: Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability. Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions. Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards. Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development. Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues. Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges. Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support. Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness. Your profile Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python. System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs. SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features. Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued. Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage. Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards. Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes. Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture. Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle. Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English. What we offer: Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation. Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace. Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility. Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals. Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed. Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility. Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance. Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us. Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle. For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process. title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Mercanis bist du der zentrale Umsatztreiber für unser bestehendes Kundenportfolio im gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise-Segment. Deine Mission: Du identifizierst ungenutzte Cross- und Upsell-Potenziale, navigierst souverän durch komplexe C-Level-Buying-Center, steuerst vielschichtige Deal-Zyklen bis zum Verhandlungsabschluss und maximierst so nachhaltig unsere Net Revenue Retention (NRR). Wenn du ein tiefes Verständnis für B2B-SaaS-Vertriebsmethodiken mitbringst und Bestandskunden nicht nur betreuen, sondern durch echten Mehrwert strategisch ausbauen willst, ist dies deine perfekte Gelegenheit. Dein Aufgabenbereich Expansion & ARR-Wachstum: Du steuerst den gesamten Verkaufszyklus für Upsell-, Cross-Sell- und Modul-Erweiterungen in einem Portfolio von ca. 60–70 Bestandskunden und triffst deine eigenen Quota-Ziele. Pipeline-Generierung im Bestand: Du analysierst deine Accounts eigenständig auf White Spots, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfälle im Bereich Einkauf & Supply Chain Management und generierst aktiv qualifizierte Expansion-Pipeline. Strategisches Closing & C-Level Selling: Du navigierst komplexe Buying Center (CPO, CFO, IT-Leitung), baust Belieber- & Champion-Netzwerke auf Executive-Ebene auf und führst kommerzielle Verhandlungen (Preisgestaltung, Lizenzerweiterungen, Vertragsverlängerungen) eigenständig zum Abschluss. Executive Relationship & Account Planning: Du erstellst strategische Account-Pläne für deine Top-Kunden, führst regelmäßige Business Reviews (QBRs) auf C-Level durch und positionierst Mercanis als unverzichtbaren Software-Partner. Vorhersagbarkeit & Deal Execution: Du steuerst deine Deals anhand etablierter B2B-Sales-Methodiken (z. B. MEDDPICC), pflegst deine Pipeline im CRM mit hoher Forecasting-Genauigkeit und arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success Team zusammen. Dein Profil B2B SaaS Closing-Erfahrung: Du bringst nachweisbare Erfolge im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb (als Account Executive, Enterprise AM oder Senior Closing Role) mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von Procurement-, SCM- oder komplexen B2B-Enterprise-Lösungen. Track Record in Deal Execution: Du hast eine nachweisliche Historie im Erreichen oder Übertreffen deiner Umsatzziele (Quota) und bist vertraut mit komplexen Verkaufszyklen und mehrstufigen Decision-Making-Prozessen. Sales Methodik & Value Selling: Du beherrschst Value-Based Selling, kannst ROI-Analysen auf C-Level überzeugend präsentieren und bist geübt im Umgang mit Sales-Frameworks (z. B. MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger). Verhandlungssicherheit & C-Level-Flüssigkeit: Du verhandelst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau oder seit mindestens 10 Jahren im deutschen Geschäftsumfeld verankert) sowie verhandlungssicher auf Englisch. Präsenz & Skalierungs-Drive: Du wohnst in Berlin (oder bist umzugsbereit) für unser Office-First/Hybrid-Modell, arbeitest datengetrieben und bringst die Motivation mit, in einem schnell skalierenden Tech-Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Warum wir? Mentoring & persönliches Wachstum: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Seriengründern zusammen, die dich in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung aktiv begleiten und fördern. Compensation: Kompetitives Fixgehalt + attraktiver, ungedeckelter Bonus & VSOP (Beteiligungsmodell). Perks: Lebe das Scale-up-Life, regelmäßige Team Events & Offsites, und natürlich: kostenlose Uber-Eats-Meals & Uber-Rides, wenn’s mal wieder länger dauert. Room for Ideas: Wir leben eine offene Kultur mit echtem Sparring, du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst den Freiraum, deine Ideen voranzutreiben. Team Mindset: Werde Teil eines neugierigen, motivierten Teams, das mutig experimentiert, offen kommuniziert und sich stetig weiterentwickelt, gemeinsam und individuell. Central Location: Unser Büro liegt im Herzen von Berlins Startup-Ökosystem, mit bester Anbindung, großartiger Energie und tollen Menschen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)
description: Role Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today. As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO. This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers. Responsibilities Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory. Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity. Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews. Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do. Role

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.

Must Have

Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators

Dein Highlight im Job

In dieser Schlüsselrolle gestaltest du die finanzielle und strategische Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens aktiv mit und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Transformations- und Accounting-Projekte. Als Sparringspartner für Management, Wirtschaftsprüfer und Kapitalmarktteilnehmer steuerst du komplexe Finanz- und Reportingprozesse, entwickelst moderne Strukturen weiter und führst standortübergreifende Teams zum Erfolg.


Deine neue Rolle

  • Du verantwortest die Erstellung und Konsolidierung der Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach IFRS, HGB sowie weiteren relevanten Rechnungslegungsvorschriften und stellst ein termingerechtes Reporting sicher
  • Du leitest strategische Transformations- und Optimierungsprojekte, beispielsweise im Rahmen von Carve-outs, Prozessneustrukturierungen oder der Einführung neuer Geschäftsmodelle und Bilanzierungslogiken
  • Du entwickelst Accounting-, Reporting- und Kontrollprozesse kontinuierlich weiter und treibst die Qualität, Transparenz sowie Effizienz im Finanzbereich nachhaltig voran
  • Du fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zu Wirtschaftsprüfern, Aufsichtsbehörden, Investoren und internen Fachbereichen und steuerst externe Prüfungen sowie regulatorische Anforderungen
  • Du führst standortübergreifende Teams fachlich und disziplinarisch, förderst die Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden und schaffst ein motivierendes, leistungsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld


Deine Stärken

  • Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs sowie über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Konzernrechnungswesen, in der Konsolidierung und im Financial Reporting eines komplexen Unternehmensumfelds
  • Du bringst tiefgehende Kenntnisse in IFRS und HGB mit, kennst dich idealerweise auch mit regulatorischen Anforderungen sowie kapitalmarktrelevanten Berichtspflichten aus und verfügst vorzugsweise über fundierte SAP-Kenntnisse
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Leitung von Transformations-, Change- oder Prozessoptimierungsprojekten und verstehst es, nachhaltige Lösungen erfolgreich umzusetzen 
  • Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und behältst auch bei komplexen bereichsübergreifenden Fragestellungen den Überblick 
  • Du vereinst starke Leadership-Kompetenzen mit einer hands-on Mentalität und schaffst es, Teams zu inspirieren, weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsame Ziele erfolgreich zu erreichen; dabei kommunizierst du verhandlungssicher in deutscher und englischer Sprache

raw.title: Product Designer (m/f/d)- Physical Products & AI - home decor brand - 100% remote - part-/fulltime
raw.description:
For my client, an established direct-to-consumer home decor brand, I’m looking for a talented Product Designer to join the team on a long-term basis.

The company creates distinctive wooden home decor for customers primarily in the US, with a strong focus on wall art alongside selected freestanding pieces.

We’re looking for someone who combines a strong design eye with commercial thinking and hands-on AI skills — someone who can turn ideas and market insights into products customers genuinely want to buy.

Tasks

Your main responsibility will be to develop new, sellable physical products from idea to launch.

You’ll identify promising product opportunities through a mix of market and competitor research, emerging trends, existing bestsellers and your own creative ideas.

From there, you’ll take concepts through the full development process:

  • Create and visualize new product concepts using AI image-generation tools
  • Refine ideas into commercially viable product directions
  • Collaborate with CAD designers to translate concepts into manufacturable designs
  • Work with suppliers and factories throughout sampling and development
  • Coordinate with the content and advertising teams to prepare products for launch
  • Manage several product concepts and development projects in parallel

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with AI image generation, using tools such as Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, Flux or similar
  • Experience designing physical products — not solely graphic, digital or UX/UI design
  • A strong eye for aesthetics, form and commercial product design, demonstrated through a portfolio
  • Highly organized, reliable and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Fluent English

Strong Plus

  • Experience in home decor, furniture, interiors or lifestyle products
  • A background working with wood, handcrafted products or similar materials
  • A strong understanding of US home decor trends and customer preferences
  • Experience collaborating with factories, manufacturers or suppliers, including product sampling and iterations

Benefits

What You Can Expect

  • 🌍 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • ⏰ Flexible setup – part-time or full-time both possible
  • 🚀 High level of ownership over new products from the earliest idea through launch
  • 🎨 Creative freedom to explore trends, concepts and entirely new product directions
  • 🤖 AI-first product development environment, with modern tools integrated into the creative process
  • 📈 Steep learning curve across product development, eCommerce and performance-driven product launches
  • 🤝 International, entrepreneurial team with fast decision-making and close collaboration
  • 📦 Direct exposure to the full product lifecycle, from concept and sampling to content, advertising and launch
  • 🔄 Long-term collaboration with consistent opportunities to develop and launch new products
  • 🚀 Start as soon as possible

If you’re a product designer who enjoys combining creativity, AI, commercial thinking and hands-on physical product development, I’d be happy to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV, portfolio and a few examples of products or concepts you’ve personally developed.

title: Werkstudent Office Management (all genders)
description: Aufgaben Unser Office Management ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – mit einem offenen Ohr, einem freundlichen Lächeln und einer guten Portion Organisationstalent sorgt ihr gemeinsam dafür, dass der Arbeitsalltag rundläuft, kleine und große Anliegen schnell gelöst werden und sich alle Kolleg:innen bei uns nicht nur unterstützt, sondern auch willkommen und wohlfühlen. Als Werkstudent:in im Office Management sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Teams nicht nur produktiv, sondern auch mit einem Lächeln durch den Tag gehen. Büroabläufe gestalten : Du unterstützt bei der effizienten Organisation unserer täglichen Büroabläufe (z. B. Catering, liebevolle Ausstattung der Konferenzräume oder die Pflege unserer Kaffeemaschinen). Erste Ansprechperson sein : Du bearbeitest selbstständig den Post- sowie E-Mail-Eingang und stehst unseren Kolleg:innen sowie externen Besucher:innen persönlich und telefonisch stets hilfsbereit zur Seite. Events mitgestalten : Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer internen Company Days – ob bei der Vorbereitung oder am Tag selbst: Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass aus einem normalen Arbeitstag etwas ganz Besonderes wird. Anforderungen Laufendes Studium: Du befindest Dich mitten im Studium, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor Dir und kannst uns mit ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche tatkräftig unterstützen. Positive Ausstrahlung: Deine gute Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, neue Herausforderungen mit einem Lächeln zu meistern, und durch Deine positive Einstellung trägst Du zu einem tollen Miteinander bei. Service im Blut: Deine Arbeitsweise zeichnet sich insbesondere durch eine hohe Serviceorientierung und ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail aus. Selbstständigkeit: Du bist strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst Aufgaben gerne eigeninitiativ an. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- sowie solide Englischkenntnisse mit und hast Spaß daran, Neues dazuzulernen. Was wir bieten Raum zu wachsen // Bleib neugierig: In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deiner Führungskraft Deinen ganz persönlichen Entwicklungspfad. Hinzu kommen informative Workshops, die Dir neuen Input geben und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung fördern. Mentale und körperliche Gesundheit // Bleib gesund & aktiv : Wir möchten, dass es Dir gut geht und unterstützen Deine Gesundheit durch eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club. Zusätzlich steht unser Kooperationspartner “Fürstenberg Institut” Dir und Deinen Familienangehörigen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite, wenn es um mentale Gesundheit & Coaching geht. Verantwortungsbewusstsein // We #care: Um unsere Welt ein kleines bisschen besser zu machen, fördert unser ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) unser Bewusstsein für umweltschonendes Verhalten. Zusätzlich arbeiten wir mit JobRad, bieten ein vergünstigtes BVG Ticket an und unterstützen bei unserem jährlichen Social Day tatkräftig soziale Projekte in Berlin. Wir packen mit an, um unserem Planeten und unseren Mitmenschen etwas zurückzugeben. Teamspirit // Bleib vernetzt: Was uns antreibt, ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Deshalb veranstalten wir regelmäßig unseren Company-Office-Day, an dem alle zusammenkommen. Neben einem umfassenden Update unseres C-Boards steht hier vor allem das Miteinander und der Austausch im Fokus. Transparenz // Wir möchten transparent sein - auch bei dem Thema Gehalt: Wenn Du Fragen zu einer möglichen Gehaltsspanne für diese Position hast, sende uns gerne eine E-Mail an ----- Wir melden uns dann so schnell wie möglich bei Dir. #Einkauf:

#Marktanalyse: 
Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du wirst lernen Kalkulationen oder Reports zu erstellen und die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge zu behalten.
#Produktmanagement: 
Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich übernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.
#Perspektiven:
Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen.
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:
Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
#Was noch? 
Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;) 


Das wünscht sich dein Team:

"Teamarbeit steht im Vordergrund, man sollte sich immer auf das Team verlassen können."

– Christian

"Wer sich entwickeln will, der kann das hier bei uns, d.h. aber auch, dass man dies wollen und zeigen muss."

– Robert

"Mir ist es wichtig, dass man sich mit dem Job und NBB identifiziert und wir alle an einem Strang ziehen."

– Manuela

Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.</p> <p>Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. For an experienced operational risk leader, this role offers the chance to modernise first‑line operations, strengthen controls, and contribute directly to how a renowned, established company continues to grow its presence in the UK/EU market.</p> <p><em>Whilst our preferred office location for you to be close to is Munich, we are open to considering candidates located near to our Bad ensuring case volumes and backlogs are managed within risk appetite</li> <li>Identify and remediate gaps across the onboarding, re-underwriting, fraud and AML transaction monitoring processes</li> <li>Strengthen the first line control environment and ensure controls are effective, evidenced and audit-ready</li> <li>Review and approve higher-risk onboarding cases and escalation decisions, Fraud monitoring and case management</li> <li>AML transaction monitoring, sanctions and transaction screening, and alert handling</li> <li>Define and deliver the automation roadmap to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and scale operations across entities</li> <li>Drive adoption of automated onboarding/KYC, risk scoring, alert triage and transaction monitoring tuning to reduce false positives and shorten cycle times</li> <li>Ensure the onboarding process offers the best possible client experience while applying regulatory requirements proportionately</li> <li>Build and develop a people strategy that allows execution upon the vision – across functions and locations</li> <li>Work closely with Product teams to ship and deliver best-in-market KYC product experiences to our customers</li> <li>Utilise data and user research to optimise the onboarding experience and transform how we fight financial crime and fulfil regulatory obligations</li> <li>Manage and optimise third-party services and outsourced vendors (1st line related) across the operating model&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide management information and reporting to the EMEA CFO, senior leadership and risk committees</li> <li>Partner with second line (Compliance/Risk), internal audit, partner banks and technology to close findings and embed sustainable fixes</li> <li>Lead, develop and scale multi-team, potentially multi-jurisdiction operations</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">Skills and Experience We Desire</span></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in payments/fintech operations, risk or financial crime, with substantial time in first line leadership roles</li> <li>Deep, hands-on knowledge of merchant onboarding/KYC, CDD, KYB, re-underwriting, fraud monitoring and AML transaction monitoring</li> <li>Solid understanding of corporate structures, UBO analysis and foreign ownership models</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of identifying and mitigating gaps across these processes</li> <li>Proven experience automating onboarding, monitoring and case management processes with measurable efficiency gains</li> <li>Experience with regulated (payment) services &amp; acquiring</li> <li>Proficiency with KYC/AML systems, TM tools, sanctions/watchlist databases and adverse media platforms</li> <li>Working knowledge of the applicable EU regulations</li> <li>Experience in client contact and managing client relationship processes</li> <li>Highly analytical with attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality of work</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively, depending on the situation</li> <li>Ability to effectively present information to regulators and/or Verifone Group Senior title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.<br>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.<br>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.<br><br><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives</strong></p> <p>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L.<br>This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.</p> <p><strong>The problem: </strong>running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth,&nbsp;quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost.&nbsp;Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're&nbsp;building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.</p> <p><strong>Stack</strong></p> <p>Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo.</p> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks).</li> <li>Strong Python - production services, not scripts.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding strategies, and the practical failure modes of multi-GPU and multi-node setups.</li> <li>A bias toward measurement. You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell the difference between a real win and a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>Self-direction. This role comes with a wide mandate; you should be excited by that, not unsettled by it.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities:</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, speculative decoding, chunked prefill, kernel-level tuning across vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and TPOT separately. Profile, identify the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, networking), and fix it - not the bottleneck you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Paged attention, prefix caching, eviction policies, cache reuse across requests, quantized KV. This is where a lot of the unrealized throughput lives, and it's an area you'll own.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8, INT4, FP8 across weights, activations, and KV. Empirical work: measure quality on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Shrink cold starts and memory footprint. Faster init, smarter weight loading, tighter memory accounting - the difference between a model that scales and one that doesn't.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.&nbsp;</li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI&nbsp;</em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Wir stellen ein: Senior Dokumentenmanager (m/w/d)

Offshore-Windenergie | Onshore & Offshore Projekte | Festanstellung

 

Die T.I.S. GmbH ist seit über 20 Jahren ein spezialisiertes Beratungs- und Serviceunternehmen im Bereich Offshore-Windenergie. Wir unterstützen internationale Kunden bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Qualitätssicherung komplexer Energieprojekte und arbeiten dabei mit führenden Unternehmen der Branche zusammen.

 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Senior Dokumentenmanager (m/w/d), der Dokumentationsprozesse professionell steuert und als zentrale Schnittstelle im Projekt agiert.

 

Profil

Als Senior Dokumentenmanager (m/w/d) sind Sie verantwortlich für die Planung, Umsetzung und Kontrolle eines projektspezifischen, bedarfsgerechten Dokumentenmanagements (DMG) über den gesamten Dokumentenlebenszyklus hinweg – von der Erstellung über Freigabe, Verteilung, Ablage und Archivierung bis hin zur finalen Übergabe.

Sie agieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Projektleitung, PMO, internen Fachabteilungen und externen Partnern und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Sicherstellung der Dokumentationsqualität sowie zur effizienten Projektkommunikation.

 

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Einrichtung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung eines projektspezifischen Dokumentenmanagementsystems (z. B. Aconex, SharePoint, ThinkProject)

  • Analyse von Rahmenbedingungen, Anforderungen, internen und externen Schnittstellen sowie Richtlinien

  • Konzeption von Prozessen zur Erstellung, Prüfung, Freigabe, Verteilung und Archivierung von Dokumenten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung, Fachbereichen und Qualitätssicherung

  • Definition und Dokumentation von Rollen, Tools, Vorlagen sowie Struktur- und Ablagelogiken

  • Erstellung von Vorlagen, DMG-Richtlinien, Projektanleitungen und Berichten

  • Schulung der Projektteams (z. B. Präsentationen, How-to-Guides)

  • Qualitätskontrolle ein- und ausgehender Dokumente sowie Nachverfolgung von Fristen und Workflows

  • Administration des Dokumentenmanagementsystems (Benutzerverwaltung, Rechtevergabe, Systempflege)

raw.title: Remote Maintenance Engineer
raw.description:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

description: Bereit, den Markt zu verändern? PAIR Finance denkt Inkasso neu: Wir entwickeln die fortschrittlichste KI-Technologie im Forderungsmanagement und haben damit die gesamte Inkassoindustrie nachhaltig verändert. Heute sind wir mit 250+ Mitarbeitenden, 600+ Mandant*innen und Standorten in zehn europäischen Städten europaweit führend im Einsatz von KI im Forderungsmanagement – und erzielen dabei höhere Rückzahlungsquoten, ohne die Kundenbeziehung unserer Mandant*innen zu belasten. Im Zuge der Ausgliederung entsteht die PAIR Finance Deutschland GmbH als eigenständige operative Gesellschaft für unseren Heimatmarkt. Als Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland übernimmst du die unternehmerische und vertriebliche Verantwortung für diesen Aufbau: Deutschland ist der am weitesten entwickelte Markt unserer europaweit tätigen Gruppe – deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn weiter zu skalieren, zu professionalisieren und profitabel auszubauen. Du gestaltest die nächste Wachstumsphase der deutschen Gesellschaft aktiv mit. Was du bei uns bewegen kannst: Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung für den Standort Deutschland: Du steuerst Vertrieb und Neukundenakquise aktiv, verantwortest Pipeline und Forecast und triffst die zentralen kommerziellen Entscheidungen für den deutschen Markt. Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Vertriebsstrategie für den deutschen Markt , inklusive Priorisierung unserer Schwerpunktindustrien (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger) und – in Abstimmung mit der Gruppe – dem Einsatz gezielter Collection-Strategien. Akquise neuer Mandant*innen sowie systematischer Ausbau bestehender Partnerschaften: du trägst die Verantwortung für ambitionierte Neugeschäfts- und Wachstumsziele. Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines vertriebsstarken, motivierten Teams mit klarer Ziel- und Ergebnisorientierung. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem C-Level der Gruppe und den internationalen Country MDs, um pan-europäische Kunden für PAIR Finance zu gewinnen, Vertriebs-Best-Practices gruppenweit zu teilen und Vertriebsstrategien europaweit auszurollen. Positionierung von PAIR Finance am deutschen Markt zur Unterstützung deiner Vertriebsziele – z. B. durch Pressemitteilungen, eigene Vorträge und Auftritte auf Konferenzen, Messen und Webinaren, sowie Weiterentwicklung der Marketingstrategie und Organisation von Kundenevents. Rechtskonformität am Standort: Sicherstellung in enger Abstimmung mit der zentralen Legal & Compliance-Funktion, die hierfür die fachliche Verantwortung trägt. Hinweis zum Geschäftsmodell: Unsere Mandant*innen (deine Kunden im Vertrieb) sind ausschließlich Unternehmen – vom E-Commerce-Player bis zum Energieversorger. Die eigentliche Forderungsbearbeitung richtet sich an Endverbraucher*innen (B2C). Dein Vertrieb ist also klassisches Enterprise-B2B-Geschäft. Was du dafür mitbringen solltest: Mehrjährige, hochrangige Vertriebsführungserfahrung im B2B-Umfeld mit nachweisbaren Vertriebs- und Wachstumserfolgen (z. B. als Sales Director, Head of Sales oder Country Manager), idealerweise im FinTech-Bereich oder in einem regulierten Umfeld wie Inkasso, Forderungsmanagement oder Financial Services Nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von B2B-Vertriebsorganisationen – inklusive Verantwortung für Umsatzziele, Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting Belastbares, kommerziell nutzbares Netzwerk zu Entscheider*innen in unseren Schlüsselbranchen (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger) Hohe Kundenorientierung und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Vertriebsmentalität – du gehst selbst aktiv auf Mandant*innen zu Klare, glaubwürdige und zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und starke analytische Fähigkeiten Echtes Interesse an Technologie und der Anwendung von KI Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Transparenz, Ownership, Execution, Kundenzentrierung, Innovation und Integrität sind für uns bei PAIR Finance keine Worte, sondern gelebte Praxis. Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen und setzen KI täglich aktiv ein, um effizienter zu arbeiten und jeden Tag ein bisschen erfolgreicher zu sein. Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bring deine Vertriebsstärke, Motivation und Persönlichkeit ein. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p>As the Chief of Staff to the EVP of Global Ad Sales, you will serve as a high-leverage strategic operator, executive proxy, and force multiplier across the Global Sales Organization (GSO). Your key function is to scale executive attention, accelerate decision velocity, and translate GSO’s highest strategic priorities into clear execution and follow-through.</p> <p>The ideal Chief of Staff operates with high EQ to maintain Reddit’s open, collaborative, and accessible culture while ensuring that executive time is prioritized for high-impact drivers. You will partner closely with Sales Strategy &amp; Operations, regional sales leadership, and cross-functional executive teams to orchestrate a seamless operational rhythm and drive global alignment.</p> <p><strong>This role is required to be based in New York or London.</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Drive Alignment &amp; Prioritization</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Filter &amp; Route Inquiries:</strong> Establish clear operational paths for routine data requests, incident reporting, and tactical items below the executive level, freeing leadership bandwidth for major revenue initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Executive Proxy &amp; Strategic Alignment:</strong> Represent the EVP in key cross-functional leadership forums, planning reviews, and offsites, building bottoms-up consensus and alignment before issues require top-down intervention.</li> <li><strong>Surface Field Signals:</strong> Synthesize customer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and field feedback directly from front-line sales teams to keep executive leadership deeply connected to market realities.</li> <li><strong>Pre-Frame Executive Decisions:</strong> Ensure material revenue proposals and strategic escalations reaching the EVP are pre-framed with clear context and explicit recommendations, allowing leadership to focus on high-order strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <li><em>Operational Rhythm &amp; Business Cadence</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Orchestrate Business Cadence: </strong>Maintain the global sales operational rhythm, including leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, strategic offsites, and key team communication forums, ensuring priorities are proactively tracked and fire drills are minimized.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Alignment with Sales Strategy &amp; Operations:</strong> Partner seamlessly with Sales Strategy &amp; Operations by translating strategic outputs into operational workstreams, leadership narratives, and review frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Executive Communications &amp; Collateral:</strong> Drive end-to-end preparation of strategic collateral, executive presentations, board materials, and organizational communications in close coordination with Internal Comms partners.</li> </ul> <li><em>Track Strategic Priorities &amp; Follow-Through</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Track &amp; Report on Key Commercial Initiatives:</strong> Track high-priority commercial initiatives and global sales bets, ensuring every key initiative has a clearly defined owner, success metrics, and milestones.</li> <li><strong>Accountability &amp; Execution:</strong> Ensure regional and functional leaders leave executive reviews with clear action items and deadlines; track ongoing performance against overarching organization priorities.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Initiative Support:</strong> Drive alignment and operational support for complex, multi-functional sales initiatives across GTM, Product, Marketing, and SS&amp;O.&nbsp;</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant experience in a Sales/revenue/business strategy &amp; operations role within an ad sales organization</li> <li>Deep understanding of the rhythm of the business in a high-growth environment</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to synthesize complex data/insights and build actionable strategies around the highest impact opportunities</li> <li>Outstanding communication and relationship building skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across all levels</li> <li>Proven track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Results-oriented and committed to driving measurable impact</li> <li>Innovative operator, accustomed to leveraging technology (i.e. AI, tooling), to scale, improve and help the team operate more effectively</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Believes in Reddit’s mission</li> <li>Is organized and can build their own structure</li> <li>Is a strong communicator</li> <li>Is an optimist</li> <li>Is humble</li> <li>Can effectively communicate with everyone from engineers to sales&nbsp;</li> <li>Is fact-based, and willing to be hypothesis-driven</li> <li>Needs limited guidance and no instruction manual</li> <li>Acts as a force multiplier vs. a barrier to their executive partner</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support&nbsp;</li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match</li> <li>Private Medical and Dental Scheme</li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Bike to Work scheme</li> <li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.&nbsp; We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.&nbsp; We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.&nbsp; For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.&nbsp; Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The role acts as the senior paid social authority for clients and internal stakeholders, leading account strategy, driving performance outcomes, and developing high‑performing teams.</p> <p>You will be accountable for translating client business objectives into best‑in‑class paid social strategies, ensuring excellence in activation across all major social platforms, and embedding WPP Media’s Social Excellence and DPAM ways of working across all activity. raw.title: Associate Product Manager (US Cards)
raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Lendable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:

  1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

  2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

  3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
