raw.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
raw.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone. 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio. Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision . Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate. Wie geht es weiter? Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten). Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion. Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität. title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it. This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show. What You'll Work On Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00. Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot. Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it. Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows. Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate. Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down. Who We're Looking For A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure. Your Background 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React. Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels. UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests. Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC). Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts. Nice to Have Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces. Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar). Building a design system from scratch. Defence or regulated customers. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. raw.title: Solution Engineer 100% (a)
raw.description:
Über die Stelle

Als Solution Engineer bei gateB übersetzt du komplexe Kundenanforderungen in tragfähige technische Lösungen. Du verbindest Beratung, Technologie und Umsetzung und begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen. 

Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen nationalen und internationalen Projekten. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee über erste Prototypen und Pilotlösungen bis zur produktiven Einführung. Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Consultants, Entwicklungsteams und Technologiepartnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Lösungen termingerecht, qualitativ hochwertig und mit erkennbarem Kundennutzen umgesetzt werden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Kundenanforderungen sowie Erarbeitung von Systemkonzepten und Lösungsdesigns im direkten Austausch mit Kunden und internen Projektteams
  • Konzeption von Workflows, Customer Journeys, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen sowie Erstellung umsetzbarer Briefings für Entwicklung und Implementation
  • Technische Konzeption, Spezifikation und Umsetzung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Partnertechnologien wie BSI und Salesforce sowie von gateB-eigenen Lösungen
  • Konfiguration und Implementierung von Cloud- und Enterprise-Lösungen einschliesslich Reports, Systemmasken, Daten- und Metadatenmodellen, Benutzerverwaltungen und Geschäftslogiken
  • Erstellung von Proof-of-Concepts und Minimum Viable Products, Unterstützung bei Aufwandsschätzungen sowie Begleitung von Daten-, Content- und Systemmigrationen und Integrationen
  • Übernahme der technischen Verantwortung und der Funktion als primäre technische Ansprechperson in Implementierungsprojekten sowie Sicherstellung von Zeit, Budget, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Koordination interner Entwicklungsteams sowie von Projektmitarbeitenden bei Partnern und Kunden; Sicherstellung von Testing, Qualitätssicherung, technischer Dokumentation, Schulungen und System-Roll-outs
  • Proaktive Ressourcenplanung, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Engpässen und kostenbewusste Beratung in der Umsetzung
  • Unterstützung des Sales-Prozesses durch RFIs, RFPs und Sales-Demos sowie Beobachtung und Einordnung neuer Technologien und Partnerlösungen im Hinblick auf Machbarkeit und Kundennutzen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung deines Know-hows, aktiver Wissenstransfer ins Team und zu unseren Kunden sowie Mitgestaltung von Software-Partnerschaften im Bereich AI und Enterprise Software


Dein Profil

  • Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang; alternativ eine technische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementation und Konfiguration von Enterprise-Software-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- oder Content-Plattformen – idealerweise auf Dienstleisterseite
  • Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Verständnis für die Anwendung von AI-Technologien und deren Integration in Geschäftsprozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kundenanforderungen, Systemdesign, Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen und Qualitätssicherung sowie Erfahrung mit Aufwandsschätzungen, technischer Dokumentation und interdisziplinärer Projektarbeit
  • Beratungs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit tiefem technischem Verständnis, hoher technischer Affinität und Begeisterung für AI
  • Kundenorientierter, eigeninitiativ handelnder und lernfreudiger Umsetzer mit pragmatischer Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Kommunikationsstark, zugänglich und souverän im Auftreten – mit der Fähigkeit, Vertrauen bei technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern aufzubauen
  • Analytische, konzeptionelle und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Verbindlichkeit in Koordination, Priorisierung und Umsetzung
  • Flexibel, reisefreudig und offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte bei nationalen und internationalen Topkunden mit technisch hochstehenden Systemen
  • Möglichkeit, AI, digitale Transformation und Customer Experience bei Kunden wirksam zu verbinden
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Freiheit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gateB aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit und interkultureller Austausch
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung
  • Regelmässige Firmenevents, kostenfreie Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst sowie Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
  • 29 Tage Ferien sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile und Vergünstigungen – weil uns Erholung, Work-Life-Balance und dein Wohl am Herzen liegen

Wir sind Teil der Hotz Group; mehr über House of Manus erfährst du auf https://www.houseofmanus.ch.
 
Aufbau integriertes Kreativ-Team 
Die Hotz Group befindet sich in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung und baut ihre kreativen Kompetenzen gezielt aus. Im Zuge dessen entwickeln wir ein schlagkräftiges Design-Team an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Marke und Design. Das Team arbeitet künftig für House of Manus sowie für die anderen Unternehmen der Gruppe. Mehr dazu findest du auch auf https://hotz.studio.
 
Unser Anspruch ist es dabei, strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken mit exzellenter kreativer und ggestalterischer Arbeit zu verbinden. Wir verstehen Strategie und Design nicht als getrennte Disziplinen, sondern als gegenseitige Enabler, die für Unternehmen und Marken nachhaltig Wert schaffen. Für unser Kreativ-Team suchen wir nach Kandidaten, die diesen Weg aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

Gemeinsames Verständnis von Zusammenarbeit
Gesucht werden Persönlichkeiten, die sich gerne in ein dynamisches Umfeld einbringen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit anderen Talenten Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Erwartungen an eine klassische Agentur übertreffen. Wichtig sind uns eine agile, unkomplizierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative sowie ein ausgeprägter Teamgedanke. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – unabhängig von Funktion oder Hierarchie. Wir suchen Menschen, die offen kommunizieren, Wissen teilen, Feedback konstruktiv aufnehmen und auch andere Perspektiven aktiv einbeziehen.


Über die Stelle

Als Graphic Designer arbeitest du an Branding-Projekten, visuellen Identitäten und digitalen Anwendungen. Du entwickelst visuelle Systeme präzise weiter, wendest Marken konsistent über unterschiedliche Touchpoints hinweg an und arbeitest eng mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen zusammen. Im Mittelpunkt steht deine gestalterische Qualität – gleichzeitig interessierst du dich für die Inhalte und strategischen Zusammenhänge hinter dem Design.

On-site, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice möglich


Deine Aufgaben

  • Ausarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von visuellen Identitäten, Corporate Designs und Designsystemen
  • Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Logos, Logo-Systemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie- und Farbsystemen sowie Bildwelten
  • Entwicklung digitaler Markenanwendungen, insbesondere Websites, Responsive Designs und digitale Designsysteme
  • Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln und Markenanwendungen über Touchpoints wie Web, Social Media, Kampagne, Motion und Print
  • Präzise Umsetzung von Designkonzepten und Sicherstellung einer konsistenten visuellen Markenführung
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen bei der Entwicklung starker und umsetzbarer Lösungen
  • Einbringen eigener Ideen und aktives Mitdenken bei kreativen und gestalterischen Fragestellungen
  • Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Entwürfen und Varianten im Team sowie gegebenenfalls gegenüber Kund:innen
  • Aktive Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung deiner Kenntnisse in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite und neuen Design-Tools
  • Bereitschaft, dich in strategische und unternehmerische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten und zur Weiterentwicklung des Kreativ-Teams beizutragen


Dein Profil

  • Ca. 3–6 Jahre Berufserfahrung
  • Sehr starkes, designorientiertes Portfolio mit überzeugenden Branding-, Website- und Digitalprojekten
  • Zwingende Erfahrung im Bereich Branding, Corporate Design und Visual Identities
  • Erfahrung mit Logoentwicklung, Designsystemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie, Farbsystemen und Bildwelten
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie eine Marke vom Logo und Grundsystem bis zur digitalen Anwendung funktioniert
  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit Figma und sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Suite
  • Verständnis von Responsive Design und digitalen Designsystemen
  • Motion-/After-Effects-Kenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Hohe Kompetenz im Umgang mit AI und der Anwendung neuer KreativtechnologienInteresse an strategischen und inhaltlichen Fragestellungen sowie die Bereitschaft, das «Warum» hinter einer Gestaltung zu verstehen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse beziehungsweise sichere Kommunikation im deutschsprachigen Umfeld
  • Gesucht wird keine reine Production-Designer-Persönlichkeit und kein:e reine:r Print- oder Editorial-Grafiker:in: Du musst Branding verstehen, digital denken und einen hohen gestalterischen Anspruch mitbringen


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte für nationale und internationale Kunden an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Marke, Design und digitaler Transformation
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Möglichkeit, die nächste Phase der Hotz Group aktiv mitzugestalten und den Ausbau unseres Kreativ-Teams nachhaltig zu prägen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Strateg:innen, Berater:innen und Spezialist:innen aus dem Brand Leadership Circle
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung
  • Regelmässige Firmenevents, kostenfreie Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst sowie Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
  • 29 Tage Ferien sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile und Vergünstigungen – weil uns Erholung, Work-Life-Balance und dein Wohl am Herzen liegen
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung

Du möchtest Marken visuell mitentwickeln, digitale Anwendungen gestalten und dabei verstehen, warum eine Lösung funktioniert – nicht nur, wie sie umgesetzt wird? Du hast Freude an hoher gestalterischer Qualität, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und daran, dich in einem wachsenden Team aktiv einzubringen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Bewerbungsformular.

Aufbau integriertes Kreativ-Team

Im Zuge dessen entwickeln wir ein schlagkräftiges Design-Team an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Marke und Design. title: Chief of Staff
description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success. raw.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

raw.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You will work with our engineering and production team in Zurich defining and implementing quality measures like incoming inspections, supply chain validations, failure analysis and product return teardowns to enable our custom AI hardware a safe and reliable operation of heavy machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.

You are our first quality hire. There is no dedicated quality team, no lab, and no playbook; you will design the test / fixture / process and then go build it. 


What you will do
  • Define what hardware quality means for Gravis from ground up
  • Design and implement testing systems, jigs and fixtures from incoming inspection to product shipping
  • Document failures, root causes and mitigations, build a failure database and review regularly with design and production
  • Teardown and analysis of field returns, drive corrective actions
  • Own supplier quality: first article inspection, qualification, audits, and 8D follow-through
  • Tighten drawings and specifications; critical characteristics, unambiguous acceptance criteria
  • Help building our long-term reliability and environmental test strategy as we scale

    • What we're looking for
  • A university degree in mechanical, electrical, quality Engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years experience in quality / manufacturing engineering in low volume manufacturing
  • Hands on failure analysis and teardowns
  • CAD knowledge for designing fixtures
  • Experience in hand metrology
  • Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken

    • Beneficial skills
  • Experience in GD&T
  • Experience in SQL / python
  • Exposure to environmental / accelerated lifetime testing (e.g. vibration, shock, ingress, UV)
  • Fluency in Mandarin
  • Off-highway, agricultural, mining or other harsh-environment equipment 

    • This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

    Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

raw.description:
As Mechanical Engineer, within Distalmotion’s Instruments – Product Improvement team, you will be responsible for driving product optimization initiatives with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and continuous product improvement for the Instruments of the surgical system.

The Mechanical Engineer brings solid experience in component and tooling design with associated impact analysis (impact on design verification, risk assessment, quality and manufacturing costs) and root cause investigation of clinical complaints and/or non-conformities.

Tasks:

Design & Cost Optimization

• Specify design, prototype, and implement mechanical components and custom tooling/fixtures with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturing, Assembly and Cost (DFM/DFA/DFC).

• Identify, justify and execute cost reduction opportunities on existing instruments without compromising performance, quality or safety.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders from manufacturing of prototypes to testing and industrialization of the products.

Impact analysis

• Perform comprehensive impact analysis of the proposed design changes, evaluating effects on manufacturing processes, unit costs, risk management and design verification.

• Evaluate financial impact of proposed design changes, including tooling/fixture investments, scrap reduction and cycle time improvement.

• Define technical requirements and test protocols and ensure traceability with the design in test reports. Supervise and participate to design verification.

• Collaborate with internal teams (Ops, QA, RA).

• The compliance with the applicable laws and standards and the design control practices is a must (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, MDR).

Continuous Improvement

• Investigate clinical complaints and production non-conformity.

• Lead root cause analysis and manage Corrective and Preventive Actions to drive continuous product quality and reliability improvements.

Requirements

Education & Experience

• Mechanical, microtechnology engineering degree or equivalent (BSc or MSc)

• At least 5 years of experience in the medical device industry or highly regulated environment (eg. Aerospace, automotive)

Technical competency

• Proficiency in CAD (SOLIDWORKS preferred)

• Design For Manufacturing experience (plastic and metal injection, stamping, …), for medium to high volume manufacturing

• Relevant experience in Design Control (Design input/output/transfer, Risk Analysis, Failure mode analysis)

• Knowledge of change management workflows

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, pragmatic and creative skills

• Good communication skills with proactive attitude and strong accountability under limited supervision

• Language: French, English

Benefits

What we offer:
